# Research

> A focused index of the six published research notes for agents working in the Socrates research area only.

For the full Socrates llms.txt see [`/llms.txt`](/llms.txt). For long-form context see [`/llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt).

## When to use this scope

Reach for `/research/llms.txt` when the agent is already committed to reading or summarising Socrates research notes. It is a slimmer subset of `/llms.txt` for that context.

## Research notes

- [When a clear explanation becomes evidence](explanation-evidence.md) — Jul 29, 2026 · 6 min · explanation.
- [The value of an honest pause](honest-pause.md) — Jul 11, 2026 · 5 min · practice.
- [The route back to an idea](memory-recall.md) — Aug 12, 2026 · 7 min · memory.
- [Maps that preserve the path](maps-preserve-path.md) — Jun 24, 2026 · 8 min · knowledge mapping.
- [When a tutor should say it is unsure](tutor-curiosity.md) — May 14, 2026 · 7 min · practice.
- [What learners keep after a session](what-learners-keep.md) — Apr 30, 2026 · 6 min · memory.

Each note is published both as a markdown twin (this index) and as HTML at `https://topodrive.top/research/<slug>/`. Both are reachable via the same `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` advertisement.

## Why we publish this

We publish these notes to make our decisions legible. If the tutor behaves a particular way during a session, there is usually a note here that explains why.

## Contact

If a research note raises an idea you want to push further — partnership, replication, or a contradiction — write to `help@addtech.site`.
